summary: The best way to ensure the dominant narrative doesn't win is to provide the techniques for students to tell real stories, their stories. Something magical happens when you give children their own website. No way you know how truth is shaped until you shape your own.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
The best way to ensure the dominant narrative doesn't win is to provide the techniques for students to tell real stories, their stories. Something magical happens when you give children their own website.

No way you know how truth is shaped until you shape your own.
